subject.title: fix(google-meet): force English UI when reusing existing Chrome tabs

question: How should the plugin handle a localized existing Meet tab that may already contain an active user meeting?
rationale: A narrow fix can avoid destructive reuse by opening a separate English tab, while full in-place recovery requires locale-independent inspection; repository evidence cannot choose that ownership tradeoff without maintainer intent.

options.title: Preserve and open separately
options.body: Leave localized existing tabs untouched, open an English plugin-owned tab for join or create, and return a clear diagnostic when localized active-tab recovery is unsupported.

options.title: Implement locale-independent recovery
options.body: Preserve the existing tab and replace English-only recovery and status matching with stable locale-independent hooks before landing the locale fix.

options.title: Accept in-place reloads
options.body: Allow `hl=en` navigation to replace an active meeting page and explicitly own that session-state disruption.

recommendation.title: Preserve and open separately
recommendation.body: Leave localized existing tabs untouched, open an English plugin-owned tab for join or create, and return a clear diagnostic when localized active-tab recovery is unsupported.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant merged history centers on this person's ownership of tab reuse, recovery, and meeting-state behavior.
